sections.title: Verify before you publish
sections.excerpt: Verify before you publish | Click 'Verify Now' and Segmently checks the DNS records you added at your domain provider. The domain has to reach a 'Verified' status before it can reliably serve your live funnel. If it shows 'Failed' or 'Pending DNS', don't re-enter the records — DNS changes take time to spread across the internet (usually minutes, sometimes up to 48 hours). Just wait and click 'Verify Now' again.

sections.title: What a verified domain unlocks
sections.excerpt: What a verified domain unlocks | Once the status turns to 'Verified', the domain becomes selectable as the destination when you publish a Web Placement. Your live funnel link then carries your own brand (for example funnel.example.com) instead of the default Segmently address — which looks more trustworthy in ads and emails and tends to lift click-through.
